description: Defines the ApplicationCurrency class representing currency data within the Fineract project, including fields like code, name, decimal places, and methods for data conversion.

classes.name: ApplicationCurrency
classes.description: Entity class representing a currency with properties like code, name, decimal places, and display symbol, including methods for creating instances and converting to data transfer objects.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a new ApplicationCurrency instance based on an existing one with specified decimal places and multiples.

methods.name: ApplicationCurrency (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new ApplicationCurrency with specified properties.

methods.name: getDecimalPlaces
methods.description: Returns the number of decimal places.

methods.name: getCurrencyInMultiplesOf
methods.description: Returns the currency multiples of value.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the entity to a CurrencyData object.

methods.name: toOrganisationCurrency
methods.description: Converts the entity to an OrganisationCurrency object.
